title: 六种话语功能
goal: 区分描述、解释、观点、建议、预测和叙述，并选择对应的回答句型。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 口语

points.label: 根据问句判断所需的话语功能
为每种功能选择合适的句型

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Test 2026 Update — Test Blueprint and Specifications
sources.used: 口语题型、题量、时间、话语功能和每题满分

body.p: 官方口语规格列出六种话语功能：描述、解释、观点、建议、预测和叙述。功能由整个问句决定：How does the group work? 问运作方式，How should the group work? 要求建议。
一个回答可以同时有几种功能。I prefer written feedback because I can reread it. 先表达观点，再解释原因。这道题仍是偏好题，because 只是引出理由。

cards.title: 问句与功能
rows: 说明特征，不讲一次事件。
说明原因，不只重复共享这一事实。
Is a shared workspace a good idea? Why?
What happened on the first day?
按顺序讲过去发生的事。

cards.title: 描述、解释与观点
rows: It has … / There is … / It is …
It has movable desks. There is a shared screen. It is open and bright. 说明特征。
One feature is the adjustable lighting. 只说特征，不加评价。
This is because … / The reason is that … / …, so …
This is because space is limited. The reason is that teams share equipment. Space is limited, so desks are shared.
We share tools because they are costly. 费用高是原因，共享是结果。
I think … / In my view, … / I prefer …
I think sharing is practical. In my view, access matters most. I prefer a shared room.
I prefer a shared room because I can ask colleagues questions. because 后面给出理由。

cards.title: 建议、预测与叙述
rows: They should … / They could … / I'd suggest …
They should add lockers. They could label the shelves. I'd suggest reserving a quiet corner.
should 表建议；may 表可能
They should add lockers. 是建议；They may add lockers. 是推测。
… will probably … / … is likely to … / … might …
Demand will probably grow. The room is likely to become busier. Teams might book shorter sessions.
Bookings are rising, so demand will probably grow.
Last …, I … / I was … when … / After …, I …
Last Monday, I joined the team. I was unpacking when a colleague arrived. After the tour, I chose a desk.
叙述讲过去的经过，描述讲不变的特征
I moved a desk after the tour. 叙述事件；The desk has wheels. 描述特征。

body.box:
Question: The seed exchange has attracted more visitors each month. How might it develop next year?
Notes: volunteers run it; packets are sorted by plant type; more shelves may be needed; exchanges began last spring.

Which opening matches the question's main function?
1. It began last spring with a few packets.
2. Volunteers should label every packet clearly.
3. The packets are sorted by plant type.
4. It may need more shelf space as attendance grows.

body.p: How might … next year 要求预测。第四项用 may need 推测将来的变化，依据是人数增长。第一项是叙述，第二项是建议，第三项是描述。

groups.text: The photography society offers portrait sessions and editing lessons. What are its weekly meetings like?

options: Predicting future attendance at the meetings
Describing the activities in the meetings
Advising the society to replace its meetings
Narrating how the society was established
items.why: What are … like 要求描述，即第二项。offers portrait sessions and editing lessons 是可以描述的内容。

groups.text: The rowing team moved its practice indoors because the river was closed. Why did it change locations?

items.stem: Which function should organize the answer?
options: An opinion about whether indoor practice is better
A prediction about future river closures
An explanation connecting the closure to the move
A description of the indoor practice space
items.why: Why did it change locations 问原因，要用解释回答，即第三项。原因是 the river was closed。

groups.text: The drama group has two costume designers. How could it avoid giving both designers the same task?

options: It could give each designer separate characters.
It once gave both designers the same costume.
It has two designers who work on costumes.
It may recruit another costume designer next year.
items.why: How could it avoid 要求提出办法。第一项用 could 给出建议；第四项的 may recruit 是预测。

groups.text: The chess club held a tournament last weekend. Describe what happened when the final game ended.

items.stem: Which opening performs the required function?
options: The final game might last longer next year.
Final games are usually important to the club.
The club should record the final game.
The players shook hands and the organizer announced the result.
items.why: what happened 要求叙述过去的事。第四项用 shook 和 announced 讲出经过。

groups.text: Question: Is restoring old furniture a useful student activity? Notes: students learn practical skills; sessions are weekly; tools are shared.

items.stem: Which opening gives an opinion supported by the notes?
options: Sessions take place every week in a shared workshop.
I think it is useful because students gain practical skills.
Tools might become harder to share next year.
Students should return shared tools after each session.
items.why: Is … useful 要求评价。第二项用 I think … because … 给出立场，依据是 practical skills。

groups.text: Question: How might demand for language exchanges change? Notes: applications have risen; organizers match partners; sessions started in May.

items.stem: Which sentence predicts rather than describes or advises?
options: Organizers match partners using the applications.
The first exchanges took place in May.
Demand is likely to rise if applications keep increasing.
Organizers should review each application carefully.
items.why: How might … change 要求预测。第三项用 is likely to rise 推测将来，依据是 applications have risen。

groups.text: The craft fair used numbered stalls so visitors could locate sellers. Why were the stalls numbered?

items.stem: Which answer supplies the requested explanation?
options: The numbers helped visitors find the sellers.
The fair had stalls occupied by different sellers.
The organizers should keep the stall numbers next year.
Visitors will probably return to their favorite sellers.
items.why: 原因是 so visitors could locate sellers。第一项的 find 是 locate 的同义改写。

groups.text: The astronomy group meets outdoors. What should it do when clouds prevent observation?

items.stem: Which function is central to this question?
options: Describing the group's usual outdoor meeting site
Predicting the date of the next clear night
Narrating the group's first outdoor meeting
Recommending an activity for cloudy evenings
items.why: What should it do 要求提出建议，即第四项。when clouds prevent observation 说明了建议用在什么情况下。

lines.text: The map room contains large tables, adjustable lamps, and drawers for oversized sheets. What is the room like?

items.stem: What kind of answer does the question require?
options: A description of the room's physical features
A reason the room changed its opening hours
A recommendation to replace the room's furniture
A prediction about demand for the room
items.why: What is the room like 要求描述，即第一项。tables、lamps、drawers 都是房间的特征。

lines.text: The volunteer kitchen prepares ingredients the evening before each session. Why does it do that rather than prepare everything on the day?

items.stem: Which function should the response primarily serve?
options: Narrating the kitchen's first cooking session
Explaining the reason for the preparation schedule
Predicting how the kitchen will change next year
Describing the appearance of the stored ingredients
items.why: Why … rather than … 问提前准备的原因，要用解释回答，即第二项。

lines.text: The campus repair cafe has a long waiting list. Organizers are considering separate queues for clothing and electrical items. What would be a useful change?

items.stem: Which response opening gives the requested suggestion?
options: The waiting list has grown since the cafe opened.
The cafe might become busier next semester.
I'd suggest separating the two repair queues.
The cafe currently repairs both kinds of items.
items.why: What would be a useful change 要求建议。第三项用 I'd suggest 提出把两类维修分开排队。

lines.text: The oral-history project has received more recordings each month. What is likely to happen to its storage needs?

items.stem: Which opening matches the requested function?
options: The recordings contain accounts from several generations.
The project should ask speakers to shorten their recordings.
The project began collecting accounts last winter.
It will probably need more space as recordings accumulate.
items.why: What is likely to happen 要求预测。第四项用 will probably need 推测，依据是 more recordings each month。

groups.text: Question: Was the peer-mediation scheme worthwhile? Explain the view. Notes: it helped students settle disagreements; mediators trained together; meetings were private.

items.stem: Which opening states a supported opinion?
options: I think it was valuable because it settled disagreements.
The mediators attended training before the private meetings.
The scheme might hold more training sessions in future.
The mediators should arrange the meetings in private rooms.
items.why: Was … worthwhile 要求评价。第一项的 valuable 对应 worthwhile，依据是 it helped students settle disagreements。

groups.text: Question: What happened when the student journal's printing was delayed? Notes: the editor informed contributors; the group posted a digital edition; paper copies followed later.

items.stem: Which opening starts the required narration?
options: The journal has both paper and digital editions.
The editor notified contributors, and the team released a digital version.
The journal should keep a digital edition available.
A future printing delay might affect contributors.
items.why: What happened 要求叙述。第二项用 notified 和 released 按顺序讲出经过。

groups.text: The climbing club has beginners and experienced members. Should they train together? Explain the position.

items.stem: Which function is required before supporting details?
options: Predicting next year's membership numbers
Describing the wall's physical layout
Expressing a view about mixed training
Narrating the club's first training session
items.why: Should they train together 和 Explain the position 要求先表明对混合训练的立场，即第三项。

groups.text: The campus parcel service used to collect packages at a desk. Last week it tested lockers. Describe what happened during the first trial.

items.stem: What does the question ask the speaker to do?
options: Recommend replacing the lockers with a desk
Predict whether lockers will be popular later
Describe the lockers without mentioning the trial
Narrate events from the initial locker trial
items.why: what happened during the first trial 要求讲试用时发生的事，即第四项。第三项只描述储物柜，不讲经过。
